neighbours.label: Finishing or embellishing verbs: rounded out, rounding off, dress it up, dressed up; promotes look, decor, aesthetic. Plain verbs in the same sentences stay quiet
fire: A spoon of honey rounded off the dessert.
The encore rounded out a great night.
Fresh herbs rounding out the plate made it pretty.
A silk scarf will dress it up for evening.
We rounded out the evening with a dance.
She dressed up the plain coat with a brooch.
Hints of plum rounding off the wine are lovely.
The band rounded things off with a ballad.
quiet: A spoon of honey sweetened the tea.
The encore ended at eleven that night.
Fresh herbs growing in the plot made it pretty.
A silk scarf will keep you warm this evening.
We spent the evening at a dance.
She washed the plain coat with soap.
Hints of plum in the wine are lovely.
The band walked off after a ballad.
